welcome.title: Project Creation Wizard
welcome.description: I'll guide you through all sections of the form. You can pause and resume the tour at any time.

tabs.title: Bilingual Configuration
tabs.description: Configure the project information in both languages. When switching between tabs, data for each language is preserved.

generalInfo.title: General Information
generalInfo.description: Define title, subtitle, descriptions and features. This information appears on the project's public portal.

nameSlug.title: Name and Slug
nameSlug.description: The name is the project's internal identifier. The slug is used in portal URLs and must be unique across the system.

propertyDetails.title: Property Details
propertyDetails.description: Define the construction phase, status, project type, location and total area of the development.

media.title: Media Assets
media.description: Upload main image, logo, photo gallery and videos. These are displayed on the public portal and documents.

brandColors.title: Brand Colors
brandColors.description: Define the project's color palette. Use format "primary:#333F1F" or simply "#333F1F". Used on portal and documents.

actions.title: Save Project
actions.description: When finished, save the project. Once created, you can configure message variables in edit mode.
